description:
Real NVENC H.264 encoder backend (T-017a). Original implementation in commit 39484a3.

Probe-layer FFI fixes (commits 9a5ff33, 1260dd2) resolved all bugs that caused T-021 rerun 5 to report `nvenc-api-create-failed:15`:

1. NVENC version-word formula corrected (`nvencapi_struct_version()` helper).
2. `NV_ENC_ERR_INVALID_VERSION` constant value corrected (7 → 15).
3. `NV_ENC_DEVICE_TYPE_CUDA` constant corrected (2 → 1; OPENGL → CUDA).
4. Six encode-path version constants centralised in ffi.rs.
5. `NV_ENC_INITIALIZE_PARAMS` struct re-laid-out to SDK 12.1 (packed bit-field flags, correct `maxMEHintCountsPerBlockRow` size, added `tuningInfo` and `bufferFormat`, adjusted `reserved1`).
6. `helper/tests/encoder_selection.rs` hardened with opt-in `COVE_NVENC_REQUIRE_AVAILABLE=1` strict mode.

Encode-path FFI layout fixes (commit 1260dd2) resolved `NV_ENC_PIC_PARAMS`, `NV_ENC_LOCK_BITSTREAM`, and related struct layouts against SDK 12.1. `nvenc_one_frame_shm_encode_produces_fmp4_fragment` now passes. Full crate test suite: 23/23 green.

T-021 rerun 6 confirmed NVENC works in production: `encoder.probeResult` returns `available: true`, `encoder.selected` fires with `backend: nvenc` on RTX 4080 SUPER / driver 595.71.05.

Evidence: .story/handovers/2026-05-19-09 … 2026-05-19-15 (rerun 6 handover).
title: Implement real NVENC backend (T-017a)
